pages.title: Electrolytic Game
pages.text: The Electolytic Game is a game of flipping lights on and off. The buttons on each side change the state of it's row. The goal is to make all lights blue, then right-click the Game block again.

pages.title: Polycharge Solution
pages.text: 10 Polycharge Solution is required to start this game.

pages.title: Electrolysis Solution
pages.text: 10 Electrolysis Solution is given for succesfully completing the game.
